collision_check.result: All four base names free; no -sc1 renames needed. Distinct from cutler (prop-blade-blank-cu1, prop-grindstone-small-cu1, prop-handle-scale-blank, prop-rivet-tray-cu1), scabbard (prop-chape-blank, prop-leather-wrap-blank, prop-throat-mount-blank, prop-wood-core-blank), prop-fullers-earth-sack.

judgment_calls: Pommel is an 8-sided wheel with a through tang hole = 64 tris (over 48 preference, under 120/210); kept the hole as required.
Grip core 44 tris (8-seg oval, 3 stations) slightly over 40 preference for a readable taper.
Crossguard blade slot not cut (would add tris); centre swell marks slot location for forge.
Textures are flat BaseColor PNGs shipped separately; not linked in FBX.
Contact sheet blade tile uses a higher camera angle so the fuller reads.
